quotes.text: This Integrated Annual Report provides the most important information about the Company’s strategy, performance, governance and value creation of its operations for the financial year ended December 31, 2025.
This Report covers the financial and operational performance of ABB India Limited for the period January 01, 2025 to December 31, 2025, unless otherwise stated.
